boundaries.name: rust_compiler_and_native_types
boundaries.obligation: Prove Rust↔Lean refinement, allocation/panic and serde/Display behavior; justify Nat projections from fixed native u32/u64 and Bytes32 types.

boundaries.name: native_signing_digest_and_imcs
boundaries.obligation: NativeEnvironment.signingDigest must be actual ChannelState::signing_digest over complete Revived+opaqueRest; hashWords must be actual Keccak over exact IMCS preimage, without assuming hash injectivity.

boundaries.name: primitive_codec
boundaries.obligation: Imported ChannelId and U32LimbTrait errors/canonical encodings and bitwise unsigned64 shift/OR semantics must match this manual model.
